title: Nomad Noé Habibi Vanilla: The Vanilla Musk Perfume Worth Knowing
summary: Vanilla musk perfume Nomad Noé Habibi Vanilla blends pistachio, coffee, and sandalwood into a quiet musk. Here's what it smells like and how to try it as an 8 mL vial.
body_markdown:
We’ve already covered our 11 favorite vanilla fragrances, but a new contender has entered the conversation:[Nomad Noé Habibi Vanilla](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/nomad-noe-habibi-vanilla-87741602064185) . So what makes it a vanilla musk perfume worth getting to know? There’s a lot to say, actually, but let’s start with the fact that it doesn’t smell like every other vanilla on the shelf.


## What does Habibi Vanilla smell like?


We’re first introduced to roasted pistachio and hazelnut which soften into warm milk. Coffee absolute and amber deepen it further, adding real richness without tipping into a full dessert note. Vanilla, sandalwood, and creamy musks linger last, quiet rather than loud, the kind of musky vanilla that reads as intimacy rather than a statement. Nomad Noé calls it emotional intimacy without words, and once it settles on skin, that’s exactly what it feels like: a quiet trace of devotion rather than something you’re announcing to the room.


## A little about Nomad Noé


[Nomad Noé](https://www.scentbird.com/brand/nomad-noe) is a modern fragrance house founded in New York City in 2019 by Corentin Hamon and Arash Yomtobian. Every fragrance is developed in Grasse, France and crafted in small batches, using highly concentrated formulas and natural ingredients. The brand’s whole philosophy is built around the idea that we’re all nomads on our own journeys, which is why each release is rooted in storytelling rather than just a note list, which naturally brings something extra into an everyday routine.

## Frequently asked questions


### What does Nomad Noé Habibi Vanilla smell like?


It opens with roasted pistachio and hazelnut melting into warm milk, deepens with coffee absolute and amber, and settles into vanilla, sandalwood, and creamy musk. It’s a quiet, skin-close vanilla musk perfume rather than a loud dessert scent.


### Who makes Habibi Vanilla?


Habibi Vanilla comes from Nomad Noé, a fragrance house founded in New York City in 2019 by Corentin Hamon and Arash Yomtobian. Each scent is developed in Grasse, France, and made in small batches with concentrated, natural formulas.


### Is Habibi Vanilla a men’s or women’s fragrance?


It’s unisex. The eau de parfum is built around pistachio, coffee, and musky vanilla notes that wear closely on skin regardless of gender, which fits Nomad Noé’s broader approach of designing scents around a feeling rather than a target gender.


### What fragrance family does Habibi Vanilla belong to?


Scentbird classifies it as Woody, thanks to the sandalwood and amber in its base, even though the vanilla and coffee notes up top give it a warm, gourmand-leaning feel. That combination is part of what makes it smell different from a typical vanilla.


### How can I try Habibi Vanilla without buying a full bottle?


A Scentbird subscription sends it as an 8 mL vial, about a 30-day supply, so you can live with it on your own skin before deciding whether to commit to a full bottle. Vanilla musk perfumes can wear differently from person to person, so testing first is worth it.
